nodes.title: 1. **ZX Platinum Credit Card**
nodes.summary: The ZX Platinum Credit Card is positioned for high-income professionals and frequent travelers, offering comprehensive travel and lifestyle benefits with premium fees and a high income/credit requirement.

children.title: Features
children.summary: Platinum card features: complimentary airport lounge access in India and South Asia, 3X reward points on international spends, travel insurance up to ₹50 lakh, fuel surcharge waiver at all pumps, and a dedicated 24x7 concierge service.

children.title: Fees
children.summary: Platinum card fees: joining fee ₹2,999 + GST and annual fee ₹2,499 + GST, with the annual fee waived when annual spends exceed ₹3 lakh.

children.title: Eligibility
children.summary: Platinum card eligibility: minimum monthly income ₹80,000, age 21 to 65, and a good credit history with CIBIL score of 750 or above.

nodes.title: 2. **ZX Gold Credit Card**
nodes.summary: The ZX Gold Credit Card is designed for salaried individuals and regular shoppers, offering everyday rewards on groceries and utility payments along with dining discounts and EMI flexibility.

children.title: Features
children.summary: Gold card features: 1.5X reward points on groceries and utility payments, up to 20% discount at partner dining outlets, zero lost card liability after reporting, and EMI conversion on purchases above ₹5,000.

children.title: Fees
children.summary: Gold card fees: joining fee ₹499 + GST and annual fee ₹499 + GST, with the annual fee waived when annual spend exceeds ₹75,000.

children.title: Eligibility
children.summary: Gold card eligibility: minimum monthly income ₹25,000, age 21 to 65, and a CIBIL score of 700 or above.

nodes.title: 3. **ZX Women Empower Credit Card**
nodes.summary: The ZX Women Empower Credit Card is aimed at women entrepreneurs and working professionals, with e-commerce cashback, an interest-free period, and benefits for women-led businesses.

children.title: Features
children.summary: Women Empower card features: a ₹1,000 welcome voucher for women-led businesses, enhanced cashback of up to 5% on e-commerce, an interest-free period of up to 55 days, and a free add-on card for family.

children.title: Fees
children.summary: Women Empower card fees: joining fee ₹299 + GST and annual fee ₹299 + GST, with the annual fee waived on spends exceeding ₹50,000.

children.title: Eligibility
children.summary: Women Empower card eligibility: applicant must self-identify as female, minimum monthly income ₹15,000 (proof required for entrepreneurs), age 21 to 65, and CIBIL score 650+.

nodes.title: 4. **ZX Student Credit Card**
nodes.summary: The ZX Student Credit Card is for college and university students in India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal, with a low credit limit, no annual fees for the first two years, and study-related perks.

children.title: Features
children.summary: Student card features: a low credit limit of ₹20,000 (flexible for students), no annual fee for the first 2 years, 1% cashback on online purchases, and bill reminders with study abroad offers.

children.title: Fees
children.summary: Student card fees: joining fee ₹0 and annual fee ₹199 + GST, waived with one transaction per quarter.

children.title: Eligibility
children.summary: Student card eligibility: age 18 to 25, a valid student ID and proof of admission, and a co-signer or proof of minimal monthly remittance/allowance.

nodes.title: 5. **ZX NRI Credit Card**
nodes.summary: The ZX NRI Credit Card is for non-resident Indians and NRIs in Bhutan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, with global acceptance, no forex markup in South Asia, and remittance integration.

children.title: Features
children.summary: NRI card features: global acceptance in over 150 countries, no forex markup on spends in South Asia, remittance integration via the ZX app, and reward points redeemable for airline miles.

children.title: Fees
children.summary: NRI card fees: joining fee USD $30 (or equivalent) and annual fee USD $25, waived on spends above USD $5,000.

children.title: Eligibility
children.summary: NRI card eligibility: valid NRI status with passport copy and visa/residence permit, minimum monthly overseas remittance of USD 1,000, age 21 to 65, and a satisfactory credit reference at home or abroad.

nodes.title: **How to Apply**
nodes.summary: Apply for any credit card through the ZX Bank Asia website or app by filling an online form and uploading ID, income proof, and address proof; e-KYC is available for India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal residents, with approval in as little as 48 hours.

children.title: **For More Information**
children.summary: For more credit card information, visit the ZX Bank credit card page, call Customer Care (India or Sri Lanka), or chat with the Zia AI assistant in the mobile app; fees and eligibility are indicative and subject to change.
